nuggets.text: Eagles QB Mason McKenzie, a transfer from Saginaw Valley State, led BC in rushing in the opener with 78 yards.
The Eagles opened 2026 with 50 new players on the roster: 23 freshmen and 27 transfers.
Eagles RB Evan Dickens ran for more than 1,300 yards and 16 touchdowns at Liberty last season.
Eagles coach Bill O'Brien was born in Boston's Dorchester neighborhood and played defensive end and linebacker at Brown.
Eagles coach Bill O'Brien was hired by Ohio State in 2024 but never coached a single practice or game for the Buckeyes.
The Eagles' Alumni Stadium opened in 1957 with a game against Navy that John F. Kennedy helped organize.
The Eagles' mascot Baldwin has a pun for a name: bald, as in bald eagle, plus win.
The Eagles' fight song, For Boston, is billed as America's oldest college fight song.
Friday is the Eagles' Red Bandanna Game, honoring BC alum Welles Crowther, who saved at least 18 people on 9/11.
The Eagles lead the all-time series with Rutgers 20-7-1.
